verdict.rationale: There is no evidence Bolt.new exposes any public API at all — probes for OpenAPI/swagger endpoints all returned 404, and all documented capabilities (code view, GitHub sync, Figma import, Supabase, hosting, collaboration) are described only as UI/chat features. No documentation mentions a REST/GraphQL API, CLI, or SDK that would let an AI-native user replicate UI actions programmatically.
